source_caption_text:
This still hits the same after all these years 😮‍💨🔥

Released in 2011, Drake’s “Headlines” became one of the defining tracks from his sophomore album Take Care. Produced by Boi-1da and Noah “40” Shebib, the song pairs sharp, punchy drums with atmospheric production that gives it that unmistakable early 2010s sound.

Drake opens with the now-iconic lines about being “strung out on compliments” and “overdosed on confidence,” setting up a track that balances his growing confidence with the pressure of fame. He addresses his critics, reflects on how success has changed his life and makes it clear that he’s focused on the people who have been with him from the start.

The song went on to become one of Drake’s biggest hits, reaching the top of the Hot Rap Songs chart and eventually earning Diamond certification. More than a decade later, “Headlines” still brings back that Take Care era, and it’s one of those Drake records that never gets old.
